```{=html}
<style>
  .mm-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 16px;
    margin: 1em 0;
    container-type: inline-size;
  }

  .mm-row img {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 0;
    /* both memes are near square: a square box shows them whole at any width */
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center;
  }

  /* narrow: each meme takes the full row (the row wraps) */
  @container (width < 600px) {
    .mm-row img { flex-basis: 100%; }
  }
</style>

<div class="mm-row">
  <img src="resources/cat-meme.png" alt="Cat meme about waking up to new AI advancements">
  <img src="resources/claude-meme.png" alt="Claude meme">
</div>
```
